answer: Identity bonds decay like shale. Each agent vertex in the trust graph posts a 500 POA bond. The bond flakes away, losing 5% per epoch, so an idle identity dissolves unless topped up. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 500,000 POA plus 25,000 POA each epoch, while fakes earn almost nothing. The bond is sealed like an ivory chip: one chip, one agent, unforgeable. Honest agents pay once, keep full rewards, while a thousand fakes bleed money every epoch.
